poema.texto:
Sueño 
                               vago
                 miles de profundidad 

                       corazón
                             congelado

                                          mi 
                                 mi
                                 mi ...

                                    mi alma 
                                                         
                                 en ascenso

                               en un ríos 
                                                              
                 de la vida
             roto
                         en mil
                              fuentes

                                                  existencia 

                  una pirámide 
                 con mil caras 
                                 no hay aristas
                                                         mi

                    bien allí 
                               donde
                                 no veo

                               vivo 
                       y no
                                                 existo
